svg.text: W1 · Full editor: Song view + Notes (proposed)
Greyscale wireframe. One ruler per pane, one tool palette, one launcher (the shelf), inspector follows the selection.
12 notes in clip · C3–G4 · clip used 2×
Instance menu ("Main ▾"): File (open, save, export MIDI / DAWproject), rename, theme,
editor size. Replaces the lone "File" button and the module-menu-only settings.
Song settings stay visible: position, tempo, swing (new: the engine already plays it,
but there was no control), time signature, song key. On narrow windows they fold into
One tool palette for every pane (Range only acts on the timeline, Paint and Velocity
only on notes; others greyed). Replaces the two copies in the arranger corner and the
Capture sits next to Record, where it belongs (was in the launcher toolbar, the record
The shelf: every track's clip slots, scenes as columns, beside the timeline. Tracks
are rows everywhere, so nothing moves when you switch. It replaces both today's
"launcher panel" and the separate launcher grid.
Drag the shelf edge (or F2) to widen it into the Perform view (W2) and back. One
Each track says what it plays: "Timeline", "▶ Clip 2" or "Stopped". ⟲ sends it back to
the timeline. This replaces the global Launcher/Arranger play mode (decision D1).
Output dot: filled = an output module plays this track; hollow = nothing does. Click a
hollow dot to add a Track Out / Drum Out beside Tessera.
Arm (record) shows only when armed or on hover; M and S stay. Rows lose the "A"
button: the ▸ arrow opens automation lanes.
Ripple, Stack and "Automation follows clips" move into "Timeline ▾"; a lit "Ripple"
badge shows here while it is on. They no longer look like tools.
One 22 px ruler: loop band and markers inside it, bar numbers below. The overview
strip becomes the scrollbar. Saves 32 px in every pane.
Clip chip: name, colour comes from the track, length (1/2/4/8/16 bars), Double, Halve,
loop on/off, export, save as clip file. Replaces the separate "8 bars" button and the
read-only clip rows in the inspector.
Devices chip opens the device strip (F3). The strip starts closed unless the track has
devices; no empty strip on a new song.
Key, "Snap to key" and "Fold" are words, not icons. Highlight moves into the key menu
"Notes ▾" holds the transforms (quantize, strum, arpeggiate…), as the ⋯ menu did.
"Ghost ▾" and the badge toggle share one View menu if space is short.
One lane picker for all lower lanes: note values (velocity, release, chance, repeats,
micro-timing), expression (pitch, timbre, pressure) and clip automation. Replaces 10
tabs that overflow in the panel.
Opening a clip always scrolls to its notes (today the melody opened at F#2 with every
